items: Guest experience combines the product experience, meaning the food itself, with the human experience of service, atmosphere, timing and comfort, and both shape your reputation and revenue.
For quick-service restaurants, judge every new initiative on two questions: did it reduce wait time, and did it reduce errors?
Improve by unifying your reviews, acting on recurring complaints, and replying quickly in your brand voice, using AI for drafts and your team where empathy is needed.
Keep guest surveys to a few clicks, with follow-up questions that appear only for 1 to 3 star ratings, and a small incentive to raise response rates.
